The spawnSync belongs to this module's OTHER gate id (typecheck), not to the class check; the obligation is file-granular, so it binds here anyway and is discharged honestly rather than argued away. The capture is verbatim stdout of `node src/gates/gate-classes.ts gate-classes --declarations declarations --registry registry.yaml --result result.json --phase m2-p4`, and the same command for m3-p1, taken on 2026-09-17 against this branch, in a scratch tree holding byte COPIES of the two real declarations named and a copy of this repository's gate-registry.yaml. The named test reads its asserted detail sentences OUT OF this file rather than carrying hand-written strings, so an implementation that prints something else reddens instead of a literal being quietly updated to match (CLAUDE.md red-witness rule, T-003 lesson 4). THE TWO MEMBERS ARE STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT, which is what makes this a class rather than one witness: the first defangs the PER-CLASS judgement so an absent disposition reads as satisfied, and the second defangs the AGGREGATION so no set of per-class verdicts can ever produce a red record.
